copy.title: The Ellison Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Larry Ellison’s family: who owns what, which stocks you can buy, the homes, and the money on the public record.

copy.h1: He bought 98% of an island. His son runs Paramount. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what each of them owns, which of their companies you can buy stock in, the homes, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from.
copy.investLede: Two family companies trade on the stock market: Oracle and Paramount Skydance. Megan’s Annapurna is private.
copy.moneyLede: The fortune started with Oracle, and he still owns roughly 40% of it. Only Larry has a published net worth.

copy.trailLede: From $1,200 in a 1977 software startup to Oracle, an island and a Hollywood studio.

summary.t: Larry’s third wife. She had worked as a receptionist at the company that became Oracle. They had two children, David and Megan.
Co-founded Oracle in 1977 and ran it as CEO until 2014. Now its executive chair, chief technology officer and largest stockholder.

owns.t: Owns roughly 40% of Oracle, per Forbes. As of Sep 21, 2026 he had pledged 413 million Oracle shares as collateral for personal loans, the company’s proxy statement says.
Owns about half of Paramount Skydance, per Forbes. He and his trust agreed to buy up to $46.7 billion of new stock to help pay for Warner Bros. Discovery.
Agreed in 2012 to buy about 98% of the Hawaiian island. Forbes puts the price at $300 million; reports at the time said $500 million to $600 million. Forbes now values it at $1.2 billion.
Put £1 billion into the institute’s campus near Oxford, then agreed in October 2025 to add £890 million to expand it to 2 million square feet. It is set to open in 2027.

record.t: In December 2025 he offered a personal guarantee of more than $40 billion to back Paramount’s all-cash bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, Bloomberg reported.

Switched his voter registration to Florida in April 2023 and made Manalapan his main home the next month. Forbes estimates that moving before big Oracle stock sales and dividends saved him about $1 billion in Hawaii state taxes.
Signed the Giving Pledge in 2010. Gave $200 million to the University of Southern California in 2016 for a cancer research center.

facts.t: Started the company that became Oracle in 1977 with $2,000. $1,200 of it was his.
In September 2025 he became the second person ever worth more than $400 billion, as Oracle’s stock jumped on AI demand.
Sat on Tesla’s board from 2018 to 2022.
His sailing team won the America’s Cup in 2010.

kidsNote.t: David and Megan are Larry’s children with Barbara Boothe. Forbes lists him with four children; it doesn’t name the other two, and neither do we.

summary.t: Born Jolin Zhu, a University of Michigan graduate. The Hollywood Reporter reported in January 2025 that she appears to have married Larry sometime in the previous few years.

worth.none: No published estimate of her own.

record.t: In November 2024 a University of Michigan alumni group thanked Larry “and his wife Jolin” for their part in securing a $10.5 million deal for a star quarterback recruit.

summary.t: Founded the film studio Skydance in 2006; his father invested heavily and became its largest shareholder. Chairman and CEO of Paramount Skydance since the merger closed in August 2025.

owns.t: Chairman and CEO. The company’s filing names him and Larry as the “Ellison Family,” which indirectly holds about 77.5% of the voting Class A stock.

record.t: Paramount agreed on Feb 27, 2026 to buy Warner Bros. Discovery for $31 a share in cash: $81 billion for the stock, $110 billion including debt. The equity was backed by the Ellison family and RedBird Capital Partners.
Warner shareholders approved the deal in April 2026. On Sep 30 the two companies said it was expected to close on Oct 6, 2026.

summary.t: Film and stage producer. Founded Annapurna Pictures in 2011, with backing from her father.

owns.t: Founder. Its video game arm, Annapurna Interactive, launched in 2016; its whole staff resigned in September 2024.

facts.t: Produced four Best Picture nominees, including Zero Dark Thirty, Her and American Hustle. In 2014 she became the first woman with two Best Picture nominations in the same year.
Won a Tony Award as a producer of the musical A Strange Loop.

summary.t: His mother’s aunt and uncle, who adopted him as a baby and raised him in Chicago. Louis had made a small fortune in Chicago real estate, then lost it in the Great Depression.

extra.t: Lanai is about 90,000 acres with some 3,200 residents. His holdings there include two Four Seasons resorts.
In 2024 he paid $277 million for a Palm Beach hotel, the Eau Palm Beach Resort & Spa.

In 2009 he bought the Indian Wells Tennis Garden, home of a top pro tennis tournament, for $100 million.
